senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אדק, הדק, חדק) [to squeeze together,] (neut. verb) to be thick, solid; to be strong.
units: Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ bot. (ref. to Gen. I, 6) יֶחֱזַק הרקיע וכ׳ let the expanse become solidified, let it coagulate, congeal; Gen. R. s. 4; (Yalk. ib. 5 יתחזק, Hithpa.).
Snh. 94ᵃ (expl. חזקיה) שחי׳ את ישראל וכ׳ (Ms. M. שהחזיק, Hif.) he joined Israel to their Father &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שחִזְּקוֹ יה</he> the Lord strengthened him.
<cite ref="Pesachim 45a">Pes. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>שעשוי לחַזֵּק</he> Ms. M. where the dough in the cracks is put in for repairing the trough.
Sabb. 146ᵇ (העשוי) לחַ׳ when the hole was filled up for making the vessel sound, opp. לשמר to prevent evaporation; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְחוּזָּק, pl. מְחוּזָּקִים.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 1:2">Sifré Num. 1</cite> <he>אין מְחַזְּקִים אלא המח׳</he> (ed. <he>תמוחז׳</he>) only the strong-minded it is worth while to strengthen (encourage).

senses.gloss: same, v. supra.—ה׳ טובה ל־ to attach merit to, to account as merit, to be grateful.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ab. II, 8</cite> <he>אל תַּחֲזִיק ט׳ לעצמך</he> do not claim credit for it (be not proud).
<cite ref="Yoma 86b:6">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>אלא שמַחֲזִיק לו ט׳</he> but He even gives him credit (for his sins when he repents).
<cite ref="Menachot 53a:15">Men. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>הַחֲזֵק לי וכ׳</he> give me credit for making Thee known &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 68a">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>בואו ונַחֲזִיק וכ׳</he> let us be thankful to the fraudulent poor &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:9">Gitt. V, 9</cite> <he>לפי שאין מַחֲזִיקִין וכ׳</he> because we must not encourage (by favors) those who do wrong.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ומחזיקין ידי עכו״ם וכ׳</he> we may encourage (greet with <he>תחזקנה ידיכם</he>, <cite ref="Zechariah 8:9">Zech. VIII, 9</cite>) gentiles at agricultural work in the Sabbatical year; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to hold, contain. Ib. 57ᵃ אין עורו מחזיק וכ׳ its skin (once flayed) can not again cover its entire body (it shrinks). Ib. (in Chald. dict.) אפי׳ שתין … לא מ׳ it would not have room even for sixty myriads of reeds.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 7:8">Par. VII, 8</cite> <he>בשביל שתַּחֲזִיק וכ׳</he> in order that it (the reservoir) might hold more water.

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:12">Ukts. III, 12</cite> <he>לא מצא … מחזיק וכ׳</he> the Lord found no vessel so fit to contain all blessings as peace; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5">Deut. R. s. 5</cite> end; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with ב) to take a hold of, seize, take possession.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 4a">Ḥull. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל מצוה שהֶחֱזִיקוּ וכ׳</he> whatever Jewish law the Samaritans have adopted &c., v. <cite ref="D00989"><he>דִּקְדֵּק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:4">B. Mets. I, 4</cite> <he>וה׳ בה</he> and took a hold of it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:3">B. Bath. III, 3</cite> <he>במַחֲזִיק</he> when one is in possession (basing his claim on possession).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>המַ׳ בנכסי הגר</he> he who takes possession of the estate of a convert (who has no heirs in law). Ib. 2 <he>ויַחֲזִיק שנה</he> that he may be in possession for one year, v. <cite ref="A02502"><he>אִסְפַּמְיָא</he></cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>.—Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ, a. e. <he>שלא הֶחֱזִיקוּ בשכר וכ׳</he> they did not cling to the duty of maintaining teachers &c.

senses.gloss: (v. חֲזָקָה) to presume, to be under a certain impression, to be convinced. Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵇ היו מַחֲזִיקִין בו שהוא בנו וכ׳ if people were under the impression that a certain person was their neighbor’s son, but in his dying hour he declared &c.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>היו מ׳ אותו שהוא וכ׳</he> if people took him to be a relation of his; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 19a">Ḥag. 19ᵃ</cite>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: (denom. of חֲזָקָה) to be presumed, be held for, be known for.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 14a">Gitt. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>בשה׳ כפרן</he> when the man is known to be a liar.

<cite ref="Shevuot 34b">Shebu. 34ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ה׳ כפרן</he> (in such a case) he is considered a confirmed liar.—Y. Kidd. l. c. bot. <he>הוּחְזְקוּ</he> if they were generally assumed (to be husband and wife); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 19a">Ḥag. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>הטובל לחולין וה׳ לחולין</he> if one takes an immersion for the purpose of being enabled to partake of ordinary food and is considered (by himself) to have immersed for that purpose.
<cite ref="Chagigah 19a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>טבל ולא ה׳</he> if he did immerse but did not have a certain purpose in view.

<cite ref="Chagigah 19a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>עודיהו … ה׳ לדבר קל מחזיק עצמו וכ׳</he> as long as he has one foot yet in the water, when he had had in view a minor purpose for his bath, he may still change it for a higher purpose.
Ib. אם לא ה׳ מחזיק if he had had no particular object in view, he may on coming out define the object for which he has bathed.—Part. מוּחֲזָק

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 8:9">Bekh. VIII, 9</cite> <he>ולא בראוי כבמ׳</he> nor does he take a double share of what is coming due to the estate as he does of what is held in possession; <cite ref="Bava Batra 55a">B. Bath. 55ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 130a:14">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite> <he>עדיין היא מוּחֲזֶקֶת בידם</he> it is still strongly adhered to, opp. <he>מרופה</he>, v. <cite ref="T00931"><he>רָפָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: being known, approved. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. V במ׳ לך when he is known to thee (to be a proselyte); a. e.

units: <cite ref="Ketubot 25b:5">Keth. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מוּחֲזַקְנִי בזה וכ׳</he> (= <he>מ׳ אני</he>) I know this man to be a priest; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 1:2">Sifré Num. 1</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 5:6">Yalk. Gen. 5</cite> <he>יִתְחַזֵּק</he>, v. <cite ref="H00552">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Berakhot 32a">Ber. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ בתפלה</he> became emboldened to pray.
